name: Da Cunnin' Plan
text: While this fighter has not been taken out of action, friendly GREENSKIN MARAUDERS fighters may re-roll failed Bravery tests caused by your warband wavering.

name: Waaagh!
text: Select up to (X/2) other visible friendly GREENSKIN MARAUDERS fighters within 6" of this fighter. Each of those fighters makes a free move action that must end closer to the nearest visible enemy fighter.

name: 'Ere We Go!
text: This fighter automatically passes any Bravery test caused by an enemy fighter with the TERRIFYING keyword.

name: Oi! Gerroff!
text: Magical ability. Select a visible enemy fighter within 8" of this fighter that is not within 1" of any other fighter. That fighter makes a free move action of up to (X/2)" directly away from this fighter, as if it jumped. If it cannot move that far away, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter instead.

name: Led'z go!
text: Magical ability. Until the end of the battle round, friendly GREENSKIN MARAUDERS fighters activated within (X)" of this fighter may increase their Fight characteristic by 1.

name: Zzap!
text: Magical ability. Allocate (X) damage points to the closest visible enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter.

name: Boss Of Da Gits
text: Friendly fighters with the GOBLIN keyword within 6" of this fighter do not roll for Animosity.
